newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation Oct load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation Oct load factor up.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Thursday its October passenger load factor increased 0.6 point to 44.1 percent from 43.5 percent a year ago.
Available seat miles increased 7.7 percent to 60.7 million from 56.4 million, and revenue passenger miles gained 9.2 percent to 26.8 million from 24.5 million.

Year to date, the passenger load factor slipped 0.1 point to 44.4 percent from 44.5 percent. Available seat miles increased 21.7 percent to 567.1 million, and revenue passenger miles gained 21.3 percent to 251.6 million.
